description: Two voltage-controlled amplifiers, each with a voltage-controlled position across the stereo output pair.

params.text: Where the first channel is placed across the stereo pair.
Where the second channel is placed across the stereo pair.
How much the first PAN jack moves the first channel's position.
How much the second PAN jack moves the second channel's position.
Sets how the level jacks are read: up the level follows the voltage directly, middle it follows an exponential curve over 0V to 5V, down the same curve spread over -5V to +5V.

inputs.text: Moves the second channel's position across the stereo pair, by as much as the second MOD knob allows.
Moves the first channel's position across the stereo pair, by as much as the first MOD knob allows.

outputs.text: The two channels mixed, right side.
The two channels mixed, left side.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
An unpatched modulation CV jack does not read 0V: the firmware drives it from an internal chaotic generator, so a MOD knob turned up with nothing patched lets a wandering voltage through.
